messages:
elena: Heads-up — final blog + press notes for Optimize 1.3 (cost/routing improvements) are ready. Target publish: 09:00 PT tomorrow. Need: legal sign-off on customer quote, PR runbook review, and an embargo plan. Draft copy below.

elena: Blog intro draft: "Today we’re rolling out Optimize 1.3 — smarter batching, dynamic routing by latency/cost, and new caching heuristics that cut median gen cost by ~18% for typical web workloads. We’ve included real workload benchmarks and a short case study with Acme Corp."

elena: Tweet draft: "Optimize 1.3 is live — faster, cheaper LLM inference across hosted & dedicated deployments. Learn how to cut token cost without sacrificing latency: https://redwood.ai/optimize-1-3"

sara: Numbers in the blog reflect the revised batching tuning we merged yesterday. Benchmarks were run on rtx-pool-4, seq=512, 99th pct included. Those are final — I can paste the bench cmd if legal wants to see setup.

mike: Good — can we do embargoed outreach? Prefer a 2hr exclusive with InfoDaily before wide send. Also need an approved quote from Acme and permission to use their logo. cc @owen for legal.

owen: On the Acme quote — we need written consent that covers use in blog, tweets, and press kits. Can you drop the email they signed? Also checking the quote for any forward-looking statements. Export control note: avoid saying specific model weights or quantization internals if customers are named.

elena: Attached (pasted) — Acme marketing approved this quote via email yesterday: "Redwood’s batching saved us measurable cost during peak traffic — 15–20% per request, while keeping p95 stable." (I’ll forward the thread to you, Owen).

mike: PR checklist: embargo time 09:00 PT, press list (TechCrunch, InfoDaily, CloudMag, SysOps Weekly), one-pager + benchmark appendix, assets: hero image + Acme logo (pending), brief for spokes. Need sign-off by EOD today to hit the cadence.

deploy-bot: publish-scheduler: Job queued: slug=optimize-1-3, scheduled_at=2026-03-24T16:00:00Z, owner=elena. Status=queued.

josh: Nice. Please also prepare a short exec note I can send to top customers tomorrow AM (one paragraph). Keep it <3 sentences.

mike: Draft exec note for Josh: "We’re launching Optimize 1.3 to lower inference unit costs and improve latency predictability. Reach out if you want a technical walkthrough." Simple and non-technical.

elena: Internal Slack announcement (draft): "Heads-up: Optimize 1.3 publishes tomorrow 09:00 PT. Blog, benchmarks, and press outreach. SHOUT if you want a quick sync — we’ll have eng-runtime on standby for 2 hours post-publish. :tada:" Thoughts?

sara: Adding eng-runtime to monitoring rota and I'll be on standby 09:00–11:00 PT. Also adding a small runbook snippet to the publish doc: 

```
If post-publish error spike: rollback-route -> switch to cached model -> alert eng-oncall -> notify #release-war-room
```

owen: I can clear the Acme quote by 18:00 PT today once I have the forwarded permission email. I’ll also run a quick check on the blog copy for legal exposures and reply inline.

mike: If legal clears, we go live as scheduled. If not, we hold and push 24–48h. Please flag ASAP.

elena: Thanks — forwarding the permission thread now. I’ll update this thread when I get the final from Owen. If all green, I’ll unlock the press list for outreach. :white_check_mark:

elena: Quick note — we’re NOT including any internal kernel/weight dumps or quantization recipes in the public benchmark appendix (per legal). Bench command and config will be high level.

elena: Final: Holding embargo until 09:00 PT tomorrow. If Owen clears by EOD we proceed. Otherwise, we delay. Thanks team.
